description: This file defines a class 'gd' which manages image processing tasks using the GD extension, including image creation, resizing, cropping, color management, and output functions.

classes.name: gd
classes.description: GD extension class for image manipulation, including loading, resizing, cropping, color management, and output.

methods.name: build_image
methods.description: Constructs and validates an image resource from various input types (GD object, resource, array, filename).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a gd object with an image source and optionally resizes it to a specified larger size.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Returns the GD resource associated with the object.

methods.name: get_width
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: get_height
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: get_prop_width
methods.description: Calculates and returns the proportional width for a given height.

methods.name: get_prop_height
methods.description: Calculates and returns the proportional height for a given width.

methods.name: get_prop_size
methods.description: Returns an array with proportional width and height based on a specified larger dimension.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the current image to specified width and height.

methods.name: resize_crop
methods.description: Resizes and crops an external image source to fit the current image dimensions.

methods.name: resize_fit
methods.description: Resizes the image to fit within specified dimensions, maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: resize_overflow
methods.description: Resizes the image while maintaining aspect ratio, possibly overflowing one dimension.

methods.name: gd_color
methods.description: Creates a color resource from RGB, HEX, or decimal inputs.

methods.name: fill_color
methods.description: Fills the entire image with a specified color.

methods.name: imagecopy
methods.description: Copies a portion of source image to the current image.

methods.name: imagecopyresampled
methods.description: Copies and resamples a portion of source image to the current image.

methods.name: imagefilledrectangle
methods.description: Fills a rectangle area with a specified color.

methods.name: imagepng
methods.description: Outputs or saves the image as PNG.

methods.name: imagejpeg
methods.description: Outputs or saves the image as JPEG.

methods.name: imagegif
methods.description: Outputs or saves the image as GIF.
